measures.title: Term limit of three consecutive four-year terms for County Executive and County Comptroller
measures.summary: Establishes a term limit of three consecutive four-year terms for the office of Onondaga County Executive and the office of County Comptroller. Proposition 2 on the same ballot proposes a four-term limit for the same offices.
measures.yesMeans: You support limiting the County Executive and County Comptroller to three consecutive four-year terms.
measures.noMeans: You do not support this three-term limit.

measures.title: Term limit of four consecutive four-year terms for County Executive and County Comptroller
measures.summary: Establishes a term limit of four consecutive four-year terms for the office of Onondaga County Executive and the office of County Comptroller. Proposition 1 on the same ballot proposes a three-term limit for the same offices.
measures.yesMeans: You support limiting the County Executive and County Comptroller to four consecutive four-year terms.
measures.noMeans: You do not support this four-term limit.
